name: spield-ops-scripts
description: Operational watchtowers for the Spield protocol. Kept as its own package for two reasons (tofix.md #23b): Node resolves ESM imports relative to the script file, not the working directory, so without a node_modules here `node solvency_monitor.mjs` fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND no matter where you cd from; and the monitors need a protocol-23-capable stellar-sdk (>=14) to decode simulations that return stateChanges — on 13.x every v1 vault view fails with 'Bad union switch: 1'. The published SDK in sdk/ pins 13.x for its own reasons; these scripts are deliberately independent of it.
